facts.note: Same regular-session Close series, observed November 26.
Unrestricted consolidated cash/CE prior to October advance.
11.873 current external + 29.989 related-party current + 30.683 external long term + 330.088 convertible net. Excludes leases. October additional borrowing excluded.
Third quarter consolidated cloud and colocation services.
Cash received YTD; already reflected in cash flow. Do not add to September ending cash.
October 27 delayed draw from existing facility. Do not net against stale September cash without a current bridge.
Initial $200m, delayed draw $100m. Project-specific, unfunded as of Nov 10 report.
5% convertible notes due 2032; 29.553 shares per $1,000 initial rate; issuer may settle in cash or shares.
Provider trailing consolidated sales. Financial-period alignment is separate from the November price observation.
2032 notes have an initial 29.553 shares per $1,000. Settlement can be cash/shares/both; include only unexchanged 2031 principal. RSUs and exercise prices require a dated roll-forward.
Form 10-Q balance sheet explicitly reports zero preference shares issued and outstanding.

Book residual: $394.181m equity equals the total $0.453m ordinary shares + $548.713m APIC - $152.991m deficit - $1.994m AOCI. Subsidiary consolidation leaves no separate NCI carrying amount. Bit Digital owns WhiteFiber parent stock, already in ordinary shares.

contracts.description: NC-1 40 MW initial colocation service order
contracts.stage: 40 MW operational at filing; initial 20 MW billing since Aug 15.
contracts.current_timing: Full 40 MW operational by Nov 10 filing; funding still has acceptance conditions.
contracts.recognition: 10-year TCV includes escalators and installation. Electricity and some expenses pass through. Actual invoices differ from average.
CAD 1.4m monthly for five years, approximately US$0.979m at filing conversion. USD outcomes change with exchange rates.

contracts.stage: Contracted; equipment delivery and acceptance outstanding
contracts.recognition: 59 months from commencement. Twelve months prepaid; refundable if the long-stop date is missed.

contracts.current_timing: Q2 CY2027 subject to equipment and acceptance.
contracts.recognition: Nine-month prepayment in escrow for deployment costs. No recognized quarterly schedule until acceptance.

valuation.reason: Mixed cloud and colocation earnings plus financing after quarter-end make a common-equity target premature.
valuation.basis: Cash flows attributable to parent common after debt, preferred and minority claims. No external consensus is authenticated in this edition.

financing.reason: October $70m borrowing and November $300m facility cannot be combined with September cash. The latter was undrawn and conditional; construction schedule and free parent cash after covenants remain unknown.

ownership_audit.history: Current five-session comparison uses the USD Nasdaq listing. Close and adjusted close agree on its two endpoints. The full historical corporate-action series remains unaudited.
ownership_audit.corporate_actions: August 2025 IPO followed Bit Digital contribution; pre-IPO parent history is not comparable. 2031 notes partially exchanged for cash and issued shares in August 2026.
ownership_audit.dilution: 2032 notes have an initial 29.553 shares per $1,000. Settlement can be cash/shares/both; include only unexchanged 2031 principal. RSUs and exercise prices require a dated roll-forward.
ownership_audit.valuation_discrepancy: Published 2.91x P/S conflicts with provider cap $294.37m / $96.93m sales = 3.04x. Use independently calculated dated share bridge and identify the basis.

report.thesis: NC-1 reached 40 MW, but project-funding conditions and refundable prepayments make signed capacity a poor guide to freely available cash.
catalysts: Acceptance and first draw under NC-1 loan.
risks: Concentrated customers, prepayment refunds and more secured debt after the quarter.
invalidation: Long-stop refund becomes due or full facility draw requires fresh equity.
missing: Term-loan draw evidence, per-order economics and October-to-current cash reconciliation.
